arxiv-2011-06081.title: Single-quadrature quantum magnetometry in cavity electromagnonics
arxiv-2011-06081.creator: M. S. Ebrahimi, Ali Motazedifard, M. Bagheri Harouni
arxiv-2011-06081.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by M. S. Ebrahimi, Ali Motazedifard, M. Bagheri Harouni. A scheme of an ultrasensitive magnetometer in the cavity quantum electromagnonics is proposed, where the intracavity microwave mode is coupled to a magnonic mode via magnetic dipole interaction. It is shown that by driving both magnonic and microwave modes with external classical fields and controlling the system parameters, one can reduce the added noise of magnetic field measurement below the standard quantum limit (SQL).

arxiv-2105-11331.creator: Philippe Bouafia, Thierry De Pauw
arxiv-2105-11331.description: Abstract . We study measurable spaces equipped with a σ \sigma -ideal of negligible sets. We find conditions under which they admit a localizable locally determined version – a kind of fiber space that describes locally their directions – defined by a universal property in an appropriate category that we introduce.

arxiv-2112-02447.title: Next Day Wildfire Spread: A Machine Learning Data Set to Predict Wildfire Spreading from Remote-Sensing Data
arxiv-2112-02447.creator: Fantine Huot, R. Lily Hu, Nita Goyal, Tharun Sankar, Matthias Ihme, and Yi-Fan Chen
arxiv-2112-02447.description: Abstract Predicting wildfire spread is critical for land management and disaster preparedness. To this end, we present ‘Next Day Wildfire Spread,’ a curated, large-scale, multivariate data set of historical wildfires aggregating nearly a decade of remote-sensing data across the United States.

arxiv-2112-12965.title: Error-bounded Approximate Time Series Joins Using Compact Dictionary Representations of Time Series
arxiv-2112-12965.creator: Chin-Chia Michael Yeh, Yan Zheng, Junpeng Wang, Huiyuan Chen, Zhongfang Zhuang, Wei ZhangEamonn Keogh
arxiv-2112-12965.description: Abstract The matrix profile is an effective data mining tool that provides similarity join functionality for time series data. Users of the matrix profile can either join a time series with itself using intra -similarity join (i.e., self-join ) or join a time series with another time series using inter -similarity join.

arxiv-2403-11862.title: Collider imprint of vector-like leptons in light of anomalous magnetic moment and neutrino data Journal: Eur. Phys. J. C
arxiv-2403-11862.creator: Parham Dehghani e1,add1, Mariana Frank e2,add1, Benjamin Fuks e3,add2
arxiv-2403-11862.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Parham Dehghani e1,add1, Mariana Frank e2,add1, Benjamin Fuks e3,add2. We investigate the impact of incorporating vector-like leptons into the Standard Model, aiming to address longstanding puzzles related to the anomalous magnetic moments of the muon and electron while maintaining consistency with neutrino masses and mixings. We find that among the various representations of vector-like leptons permitted by the Standard Model gauge symmetry, only weak doublets and singlets offer satisfactory solutions, all associated with a significantly constrained parameter space.

arxiv-2403-12733.title: Small Scale Reflection for the Working Lean User
arxiv-2403-12733.creator: Vladimir Gladshtein, George Pîrlea, Ilya Sergey
arxiv-2403-12733.description: Abstract We present the design and implementation of the Small Scale Reflection proof methodology and tactic language ( a.k.a. SSR) for the Lean 4 proof assistant. Like its Coq predecessor Space Sci. Rev., our Lean 4 implementation, dubbed LeanSSR , provides powerful rewriting principles and means for effective management of hypotheses in the proof context. arxiv-2502-01333.title: A Bayesian theory for estimation of biodiversity
arxiv-2502-01333.creator: Tommaso Rigon, Ching-Lung Hsu, David B. Dunson
arxiv-2502-01333.description: Abstract Statistical inference on biodiversity has a rich history going back to RA Fisher. An influential ecological theory suggests the existence of a fundamental biodiversity number, denoted α \alpha , which coincides with the precision parameter of a Dirichlet process ( dp ).

arxiv-2504-02796.title: Suppression of decoherence dynamics by a dissipative bath at strong coupling
arxiv-2504-02796.creator: Jitian Chen ×, Jakub Garwoła ×, Dvira Segal
arxiv-2504-02796.description: Abstract Control of decoherence in open quantum systems has become a topic of great interest due to the emergence of quantum technologies that depend on quantum coherent effects. In this work, we investigate the decoherence dynamics of systems coupled to multiple baths through noncommuting systems’ operators, and beyond the weak system-bath coupling limit.

pmc-10693124.title: Antibiotic-Resistant Arcobacter spp. in commercial and smallholder farm animals in Asante Akim North Municipality, Ghana and Korogwe Town Council, Tanzania: a cross-sectional study
pmc-10693124.creator: Ellis Kobina Paintsil, Linda Aurelia Ofori, Charity Wiafe Akenten, Andreas E Zautner, Joyce Mbwana, Neyaz Ahmed Khan, John P A Lusingu, Joseph Kaseka, Daniel T R Minja, Samwel Gesase, Anna Jaeger, Maike Lamshöft, Jürgen May, Kwasi Obiri-Danso, Ralf Krumkamp, Denise Dekker
pmc-10693124.description: BackgroundArcobacter species are considered emerging foodborne pathogens that can potentially cause serious infections in animals and humans. This cross-sectional study determined the frequency of potentially pathogenic Arcobacter spp. in both commercial and smallholder farm animals in Ghana and Tanzania. A total of 1585 and 1047 (poultry and livestock) samples were collected in Ghana and Tanzania, respectively.

pmc-10695496.title: Predictive factors of distal radioulnar joint instability after surgical treatment of distal radius fractures
pmc-10695496.creator: Chenfei Li, Lingde Kong, Xuyang Shi, Zuzhuo Zhang, Jian Lu, Bing Zhang
pmc-10695496.description: Distal radioulnar joint (DRUJ) instability is a common postoperative complication of distal radius fractures, seriously impacting patients’ quality of life. This study investigated its possible influencing factors to determine prognosis and to guide treatment better. We retrospectively included a series of patients with distal radius fractures that underwent volar locking plate fixation. Basic patient information and imaging parameters were collected.

pmc-10710557.title: Blood pressure and renal function responses in workers exposed to lead for up to six years
pmc-10710557.creator: Yu‐Ling Yu, De‐Wei An, Wen‐Yi Yang, Peter Verhamme, Karel Allegaert, Tim S Nawrot, Jan A Staessen
pmc-10710557.description: The Study for Promotion of Health in Recycling Lead (SPHERL) assessed the blood pressure (BP) and renal function (RF) responses for up to 6 years in the workers without previous occupational lead exposure. BP was the average of five consecutive readings and the estimated glomerular filtration rate was derived from serum creatinine (eGFRcrt) and cystatin C (eGFRcys).

pmc-11405883.title: Housing RCS rats under specific pathogen-free conditions mildly ameliorates retinal degeneration and alters intestine microbiota
pmc-11405883.creator: Hadas Ketter-Katz, Rawan Saeed, Ifat Sher, Gali Altmann, Tal Shadi, Shada Dallasheh, Yael Lustig-Barzelay, Amit Sabo, George Jejelava, Rotem Hadar, Gilat Efroni, Amnon Amir, Tzipi Braun, Yael Haberman, Ygal Rotenstreich
pmc-11405883.description: Retinitis pigmentosa (RP) is a genetic blinding disease with over 80 causative genes. Disease progression varies between patients with similar genetic backgrounds. We assessed the association between environment, gut microbiota, and retinal degeneration in the RP rat model Royal College of Surgeons (RCS).

pmc-12436091.title: Riboflavin in neurological diseases: therapeutic advances, metabolic insights, and emerging genetic strategies
pmc-12436091.creator: Zhiming Tao, Jinglu Huo, Xiaosheng Hao, Jianmin Liang
pmc-12436091.description: BackgroundRiboflavin (vitamin B2), a precursor of flavin mononucleotide (FMN) and flavin adenine dinucleotide (FAD), is essential for mitochondrial function, redox balance, and neuronal viability. Impairments in riboflavin transport and metabolism contribute to a growing spectrum of neurological diseases.ObjectiveThis review provides a comprehensive update on the therapeutic applications, metabolic mechanisms, and gene-based strategies involving riboflavin in neurological disorders.

pmc-12555406.title: The role of socioeconomic factors in perinatal mortality: a case-control study in Istanbul
pmc-12555406.creator: S Girgin, S TuncNakis, O Karabacak, M A Sezerol, S Hidiroglu, P Ay
pmc-12555406.description: BackgroundSocioeconomic inequalities affect perinatal mortality (PM). This study aimed to investigate the relationship between socioeconomic status (SES) and PM in a district of Istanbul using a comprehensive SES index for the first time in Türkiye.MethodsThis case-control study was conducted in Istanbul, including perinatal deaths (2021-2023) as cases and randomly selected live births from the same period and district as controls.

pmc-12560420.title: BioSet2Vec: extraction of k-mer dictionaries from multiple sets of biological sequences via big data technologies
pmc-12560420.creator: Ylenia Galluzzo, Raffaele Giancarlo, Simona E. Rombo, Filippo Utro
pmc-12560420.description: BackgroundIn several contexts involving large collections of sets of biological sequences, a relevant problem is that of selecting significant groups of k-mers that characterize one set with regards to the others in the same collection.ResultsHere a software framework is proposed implementing a novel methodology for the extraction of k-mer dictionaries, from multiple sets of biological sequences.

pmc-13602091.creator: V. Groves, M. Morissette, L. Nagpal, N. E. Mandrak, L. J. Chapman
